field.name: dsi_host_cfg_noncontinuous_clk
field.description: Sets the Host Controller into non-continuous MIPI clock mode. When in non-continuous clock mode, the high speed clock will transistion into low power mode between transmissions.

enumeratedValue.name: dsi_host_cfg_noncontinuous_clk_0
enumeratedValue.description: Continuous high speed clock

enumeratedValue.name: dsi_host_cfg_noncontinuous_clk_1
enumeratedValue.description: Non-Continuous high speed clock

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_pre
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after enabling the clock lane for HS operation before enabling the data lanes for HS operation. This setting represents the TCLK-PRE DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_post
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) to wait before putting the clock lane into LP mode after the data lanes have been detected to be in Stop State. This setting represents the DPHY timing parameters TLPX + TCLK-PREPARE + TCLK-ZERO + TCLK-PRE requirement for the clock lane before the data lane is allowed to change from LP11 to start a high speed transmission. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_tx_gap
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after the clock lane has been put into LP mode before enabling the clock lane for HS mode again. This setting represents the THS-EXIT DPHY timing parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_autoinsert_eotp
field.description: Enables the Host Controller to automatically insert an EoTp short packet when switching from HS to LP mode. 1'b0 - EoTp is not automatically inserted 1'b1 - EoTp is automatically inserted

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_extra_cmds_after_eotp
field.description: Configures the DSI Host Controller to send extra End Of Transmission Packets after the end of a packet. The value is the number of extra EOTP packets sent.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_htx_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host High Speed TX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_lrx_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host low power RX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_bta_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host Bus Turn Around (BTA) timeout in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_twakeup
field.description: DPHY Twakeup timing parameter. Sets the number of clk_esc clock periods to keep a clock or data lane in Mark-1 state after exiting ULPS. The MIPI DPHY spec requires a minimum of 1ms in Mark-1 state after leaving ULPS.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency measurement performed with REF frequency > CUT Frequency.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency measurement performed with REF frequency < CUT Frequency.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: CUT period measurement performed.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger based measurement performed. Note, each trigger pulse must be held for at least 2 ref_clk cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_START_POL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Rising edge of TRIGGER[TRIG_START_SEL] will begin the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_START_POL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Falling edge of TRIGGER[TRIG_START_SEL] will begin the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_END_POL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Rising edge of TRIGER[TRIG_END_SEL] will end the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: WDZST_0
enumeratedValue.description: Continue timer operation (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDZST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Suspend the watchdog timer.

enumeratedValue.name: WDBG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Continue WDOG timer operation (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDBG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Suspend the watchdog timer.

enumeratedValue.name: WDE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable the Watchdog (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable the Watchdog.

enumeratedValue.name: WDT_0
enumeratedValue.description: No effect on WDOG_B (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Assert WDOG_B upon a Watchdog Time-out event.

enumeratedValue.name: SRS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Assert system reset signal.

enumeratedValue.name: SRS_1
enumeratedValue.description: No effect on the system (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Assert WDOG_B output.

enumeratedValue.name: WDA_1
enumeratedValue.description: No effect on system (Default).

field.name: SRE
field.description: software reset extension, an option way to generate software reset

enumeratedValue.name: SRE_0
enumeratedValue.description: using original way to generate software reset (default)

enumeratedValue.name: SRE_1
enumeratedValue.description: using new way to generate software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: WDW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Continue WDOG timer operation (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WDW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Suspend WDOG timer operation.

enumeratedValue.name: WT_0
enumeratedValue.description: - 0.5 Seconds (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WT_1
enumeratedValue.description: - 1.0 Seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WT_2
enumeratedValue.description: - 1.5 Seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WT_3
enumeratedValue.description: - 2.0 Seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WT_255
enumeratedValue.description: - 128 Seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WSR_21845
enumeratedValue.description: Write to the Watchdog Service Register (WDOG_WSR).

enumeratedValue.name: WSR_43690
enumeratedValue.description: Write to the Watchdog Service Register (WDOG_WSR).

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_0
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_1
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0.5 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_4
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 2 seconds (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_255
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 127.5 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WTIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt has occurred (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WTIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt has occurred

enumeratedValue.name: WIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable Interrupt (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable Interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is enabled (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TST_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog test mode disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog user mode enabled. (Watchdog test mode disabled.) After testing the watchdog, software should use this setting to indicate that the watchdog is functioning normally in user mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TST_2
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog test mode enabled, only the low byte is used. CNT[CNTLOW] is compared with TOVAL[TOVALLOW].

enumeratedValue.name: TST_3
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog test mode enabled, only the high byte is used. CNT[CNTHIGH] is compared with TOVAL[TOVALHIGH].

enumeratedValue.name: UPDATE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Updates not allowed. After the initial configuration, the watchdog cannot be later modified without forcing a reset.

enumeratedValue.name: UPDATE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Updates allowed. Software can modify the watchdog configuration registers within 255 bus clocks after performing the unlock write sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: INT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog interrupts are disabled. Watchdog resets are not delayed.

enumeratedValue.name: INT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog interrupts are enabled. Watchdog resets are delayed by 255 bus clocks from the interrupt vector fetch.

enumeratedValue.name: EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: RCS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reconfiguring WDOG.

enumeratedValue.name: RCS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reconfiguration is successful.

enumeratedValue.name: ULK_0
enumeratedValue.description: WDOG is locked.

enumeratedValue.name: ULK_1
enumeratedValue.description: WDOG is unlocked.

enumeratedValue.name: PRES_0
enumeratedValue.description: 256 prescaler disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PRES_1
enumeratedValue.description: 256 prescaler enabled.

field.name: CMD32EN
field.description: Enables or disables WDOG support for 32-bit (otherwise 16-bit or 8-bit) refresh/unlock command write words

enumeratedValue.name: CMD32EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables support for 32-bit refresh/unlock command write words. Only 16-bit or 8-bit is supported.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD32EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables support for 32-bit refresh/unlock command write words. 16-bit or 8-bit is NOT supported.

enumeratedValue.name: FLG_0
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: FLG_1
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: WIN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Window mode disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: WIN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Window mode enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: RES_0
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 13-bit differential/12-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: RES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 16-bit differential/15-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: DIFFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Differential operation not supported.

enumeratedValue.name: DIFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Differential operation supported. CMDLa[DIFF] and CMDLa[ABSEL] control fields implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: MVI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Single voltage reference high (VREFH) input supported.

enumeratedValue.name: MVI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Multiple voltage reference high (VREFH) inputs supported.

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Channel scaling not supported.

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Channel scaling supported. 1-bit CSCALE control field.

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_6
enumeratedValue.description: Channel scaling supported. 6-bit CSCALE control field.

field.name: VR1RNGI
field.description: Voltage Reference 1 Range Control Bit Implemented

enumeratedValue.name: VR1RNGI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Range control not required. CFG[VREF1RNG] is not implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: VR1RNGI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Range control required. CFG[VREF1RNG] is implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: IADCKI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Internal clock source not implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: IADCKI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Internal clock source (and CFG[ADCKEN]) implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: CALOFSI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Offset calibration and offset trimming not implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: CALOFSI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Offset calibration and offset trimming implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 1 dataword.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 4 datawords.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_8
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 8 datawords.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_16
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 16 datawords.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_32
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 32 datawords.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOSIZE_64
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO depth = 64 datawords.

enumeratedValue.name: ADCEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ADCEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: RST_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC logic is not reset.

enumeratedValue.name: RST_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC logic is reset.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is enabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is disabled in Doze mode.

field.name: TRIG_SRC
field.description: The hardware trigger resource is from ADC_ETC or legacy hw_trg

enumeratedValue.name: RSTFIFO_0
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTFIFO_1
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is reset.

enumeratedValue.name: RDY_0
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO data level not above watermark level.

enumeratedValue.name: RDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO holding data above watermark level.

enumeratedValue.name: FOF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No result FIFO overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: FOF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one result FIFO overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: ADC_ACTIVE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The ADC is IDLE. There are no pending triggers to service and no active commands are being processed.

enumeratedValue.name: ADC_ACTIVE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The ADC is processing a conversion, running through the power up delay, or servicing a trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 0 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 1 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_2
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 2 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_3
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) from the associated Trigger number is currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_4
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) from the associated Trigger number is currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_5
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) from the associated Trigger number is currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_6
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) from the associated Trigger number is currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_7

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current conversion is completed (including averaging iterations if enabled) and stored to the RESFIFO before the higher priority trigger/command is initiated. Note that compare until true commands can be interrupted prior to resulting in a true conversion.

enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). enumeratedValue.name: RWUID_1

enumeratedValue.name: MSBF_1
enumeratedValue.description: MSB (bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit depending on the setting of CTRL[M], CTRL[PE] and BAUD[M10]. Further, the first bit received after the start bit is identified as bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6 depending on the setting of CTRL[M] and CTRL[PE].

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: CTS has no effect on the transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables clear-to-send operation. The transmitter checks the state of CTS each time it is ready to send a character. If CTS is asserted, the character is sent. If CTS is deasserted, the signal TXD remains in the mark state and transmission is delayed until CTS is asserted. Changes in CTS as a character is being sent do not affect its transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When a character is placed into an empty transmitter data buffer , RTS asserts one bit time before the start bit is transmitted. RTS deasserts one bit time after all characters in the transmitter data buffer and shift register are completely sent, including the last stop bit.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSPOL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter RTS is active low.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSPOL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter RTS is active high.

enumeratedValue.name: RXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The receiver has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: RXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: RTS is deasserted if the receiver data register is full or a start bit has been detected that would cause the receiver data register to become full. RTS is asserted if the receiver data register is not full and has not detected a start bit that would cause the receiver data register to become full.

field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: ARDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Read Access to IP RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by IP Bus. AHB Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ARDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by AHB Bus. IP Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will always return data zero but no bus error response.

field.name: ATDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Write Access to IP TX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by IP Bus. AHB Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: ATDFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by AHB Bus. IP Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will be ignored but no bus error response.

field.name: SERCLKDIV

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_0
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 1

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_1
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 2

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_2
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 3

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_3
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 4

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_4
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 5

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_5
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 6

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_6
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 7

enumeratedValue.name: SERCLKDIV_7
enumeratedValue.description: Divided by 8

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (A_DATA[3:0] and B_DATA[3:0]).

enumeratedValue.name: COMBINATIONEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: COMBINATIONEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable.

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCLK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCLK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).

enumeratedValue.name: SCKFREERUNEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKFREERUNEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: AHBBUSWAIT
field.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmitted after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles

field.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT
field.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: individual_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write) .

enumeratedValue.name: individual
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support. This field affects the last beat of AHB write access, refer for more details about AHB bufferable write.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is word-addressable.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

enumeratedValue.name: READSZALIGN_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size will be decided by other register setting like PREFETCH_EN,OTFAD_EN...

enumeratedValue.name: READSZALIGN_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size to up size to 8 bytes aligned, no prefetching

field.name: CLRINSTRPTR
field.description: Clear the instruction pointer which is internally saved pointer by JMP_ON_CS. Refer Programmable Sequence Engine for details.

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_1

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This will cause the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (serial root clock). If serial root clock is >= 100 MHz, DLLEN set to 0x1, OVRDEN set to =0x0, then SLVDLYTARGET setting of 0xF is recommended.

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_3
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by suspended command (resumed).

field.name: AHBCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence index when an AHB command error is detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: AHBCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when AHB command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: No error.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: AHB Write command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_14
enumeratedValue.description: Sequence execution timeout.

field.name: IPCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence Index when IP command error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[IPCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: IPCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when IP command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[IPCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: No error.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: IP command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: There is unknown instruction opcode in the sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_SDR/DUMMY_RWDS_SDR used in DDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_5
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction DUMMY_DDR/DUMMY_RWDS_DDR used in SDR sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_6
enumeratedValue.description: Flash access start address exceed the whole flash address range (A1/A2/B1/B2).

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_14
enumeratedValue.description: Sequence execution timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCMDERRCODE_15
enumeratedValue.description: Flash boundary crossed.

enumeratedValue.name: CCTX_3

enumeratedValue.name: CRCE_1

enumeratedValue.description: OTFAD has decryption disabled. All data fetched by the QuadSPI bypasses OTFAD processing.

enumeratedValue.name: GE_1
enumeratedValue.description: OTFAD has decryption enabled, and processes data fetched by the QuadSPI as defined by the hardware configuration.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Operating in Normal mode (NRM)

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Unused (reserved)

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Unused (reserved)

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Operating in Logically Disabled Mode (LDM)

enumeratedValue.name: RRAM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Register access is fully enabled. The OTFAD programming model registers can be accessed "normally".

enumeratedValue.name: RRAM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Register access is restricted and only the CR, SR, CRC and optional MDPC registers can be accessed; others are treated as RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: GEM_0
enumeratedValue.description: OTFAD is disabled. All data fetched by the QuadSPI bypasses OTFAD processing.

enumeratedValue.name: GEM_1
enumeratedValue.description: OTFAD is enabled, and processes data fetched by the QuadSPI as defined by the hardware configuration.

enumeratedValue.name: VLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Context is invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: VLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Context is valid.

enumeratedValue.name: ADE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bypass the fetched data.

enumeratedValue.name: ADE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Perform the CTR-AES128 mode decryption on the fetched data.

enumeratedValue.name: RO_0
enumeratedValue.description: The context registers can be accessed normally (as defined by SR[RRAM]).

enumeratedValue.name: RO_1
enumeratedValue.description: The context registers are read-only and accesses may be further restricted based on SR[RRAM].

enumeratedValue.name: MDIS_0

field.name: WQOS
field.description: Weight of QOS calculation. AXI bus access has AxQOS signal set, which is used as a priority indicator for the associated write or read transaction. A higher value indicates a higher priority transaction. AxQOS is multiplied by WQOS to get weight score.

field.name: WAGE
field.description: Weight of AGE calculation. Each command in queue has an age signal to indicate its wait period. It is multiplied by WAGE to get weight score.

field.name: WSH
field.description: Weight of Slave Hit without read/write switch. This weight score is valid when queue command's slave is same as current executing command without read/write operation switch.

field.name: WRWS
field.description: Weight of slave hit with Read/Write Switch. This weight score is valid when queue command's slave is same as current executing command with read/write operation switch.

field.name: WQOS
field.description: Weight of QOS calculation. AXI bus access has AxQOS signal set, which is used as a priority indicator for the associated write or read transaction. A higher value indicates a higher priority transaction. AxQOS is multiplied by WQOS to get weight score.

field.name: WAGE
field.description: Weight of AGE calculation. Each command in queue has an age signal to indicate its wait period. It is multiplied by WAGE to get weight score.

field.name: WPH
field.description: Weight of Page Hit. This weight score is valid when queue command's page hits current executing command.

field.name: WRWS
field.description: Weight of slave hit without Read/Write Switch. This weight score is valid when queue command's read/write operation is same as current executing command.

field.name: WBR
field.description: Weight of Bank Rotation. This weight score is valid when queue command's bank is not same as current executing command.

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This causes the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (ipgclock).

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

enumeratedValue.description: The Main Counter and Prescaler Counter restart counting from their frozen values after GPT is enabled (EN=1).

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO_COUNT
enumeratedValue.description: The Main Counter and Prescaler Counter values are reset to 0 after GPT is enabled (EN=1).

enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in Debug mode.

enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in Debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT_EN
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in Wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZE_DIS
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZE_EN
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_DIS
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is disabled in Stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_EN
enumeratedValue.description: GPT is enabled in Stop mode.

enumeratedValue.description: No clock

enumeratedValue.description: Peripheral Clock (ipg_clk)

enumeratedValue.name: CLOCK_010
enumeratedValue.description: High Frequency Reference Clock (ipg_clk_highfreq)

enumeratedValue.name: CLOCK_011
enumeratedValue.description: External Clock

enumeratedValue.description: Low Frequency Reference Clock (ipg_clk_32k)

enumeratedValue.description: Crystal oscillator as Reference Clock (ipg_clk_24M)

enumeratedValue.name: RESTART
enumeratedValue.description: Restart mode. After a compare event, the counter resets to 0x0000_0000 and resumes counting.

enumeratedValue.name: FREE_RUN
enumeratedValue.description: Free-Run mode. After a compare event, the counter continues counting until 0xFFFF_FFFF and then rolls over to 0.

enumeratedValue.description: 24-MHz clock enabled

enumeratedValue.description: GPT is in software reset state

field.name: OM1
field.description: Output Compare Operating Mode for Channel 1

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Output disabled. No response on pin.

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle output pin

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Clear output pin

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set output pin

enumeratedValue.name: PULSE
enumeratedValue.description: Generate a low pulse that is one input clock cycle wide on the output pin. When OMn is first programmed as 1xx, the output pin is set to one immediately on the next input clock (if it was not one already). "Input clock" here refers to the clock selected by the CLKSRC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: COINIT_0

enumeratedValue.name: COINIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Co-channel counter/timers may force a re-initialization of this counter/timer

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count up.

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count down.

enumeratedValue.name: LENGTH_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count until roll over at $FFFF and continue from $0000.

enumeratedValue.name: LENGTH_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare, then re-initialize. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, alternating values of COMP1 and COMP2 are used to generate successful comparisons. For example, the counter counts until a COMP1 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP2 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP1 value is reached, and so on.

enumeratedValue.name: ONCE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count repeatedly.

enumeratedValue.name: ONCE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare and then stop. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, the counter re-initializes after reaching the COMP1 value, continues to count to the COMP2 value, and then stops.

enumeratedValue.name: CM_0
enumeratedValue.description: No operation

enumeratedValue.name: CM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count rising edges of primary sourceRising edges are counted only when SCTRL[IPS] = 0. Falling edges are counted when SCTRL[IPS] = 1. If the primary count source is IP bus clock divide by 1, only rising edges are counted regardless of the value of SCTRL[IPS].

enumeratedValue.name: CM_2
enumeratedValue.description: Count rising and falling edges of primary sourceIP bus clock divide by 1 cannot be used as a primary count source in edge count mode.

enumeratedValue.name: CM_3
enumeratedValue.description: Count rising edges of primary source while secondary input high active

enumeratedValue.name: CM_4
enumeratedValue.description: Quadrature count mode, uses primary and secondary sources

enumeratedValue.name: CM_5
enumeratedValue.description: Count rising edges of primary source; secondary source specifies directionRising edges are counted only when SCTRL[IPS] = 0. Falling edges are counted when SCTRL[IPS] = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: CM_6
enumeratedValue.description: Edge of secondary source triggers primary count until compare

enumeratedValue.name: CM_7
enumeratedValue.description: Cascaded counter mode (up/down)The primary count source must be set to one of the counter outputs.

register.name: SCTRL0
register.description: Timer Channel Status and Control Register

enumeratedValue.name: OEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The external pin is configured as an input.

enumeratedValue.name: OEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The OFLAG output signal is driven on the external pin. Other timer groups using this external pin as their input see the driven value. The polarity of the signal is determined by OPS.

enumeratedValue.name: OPS_0
enumeratedValue.description: True polarity.

enumeratedValue.name: OPS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Inverted polarity.

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Capture function is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Load capture register on rising edge (when IPS=0) or falling edge (when IPS=1) of input

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Load capture register on falling edge (when IPS=0) or rising edge (when IPS=1) of input

enumeratedValue.name: CAPTURE_MODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Load capture register on both edges of input

enumeratedValue.description: Never preload

enumeratedValue.description: Load upon successful compare with the value in COMP1

enumeratedValue.name: UP_0
enumeratedValue.description: The last count was in the DOWN direction.

enumeratedValue.name: UP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last count was in the UP direction.

enumeratedValue.name: TCI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Stop counter upon receiving a second trigger event while still counting from the first trigger event.

enumeratedValue.name: TCI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reload the counter upon receiving a second trigger event while still counting from the first trigger event.

enumeratedValue.name: ROC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not reload the counter on a capture event.

enumeratedValue.name: ROC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reload the counter on a capture event.

enumeratedValue.description: Counter can be re-initialized only with the LOAD register.

enumeratedValue.name: ALT_LOAD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Counter can be re-initialized with the LOAD or CMPLD2 registers depending on count direction.

enumeratedValue.name: FAULT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Fault function disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: FAULT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Fault function enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Continue with normal operation during debug mode. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Halt TMR counter during debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_EN_2
enumeratedValue.description: Force TMR output to logic 0 (prior to consideration of SCTRL[OPS]).

enumeratedValue.name: DBG_EN_3
enumeratedValue.description: Both halt counter and force output to 0 during debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENBL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Timer channel is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENBL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Timer channel is enabled. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Asserted while counter is active

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Clear OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Set OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_4
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle OFLAG output using alternating compare registers

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_5
enumeratedValue.description: Set on compare, cleared on secondary source input edge

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_6
enumeratedValue.description: Set on compare, cleared on counter rollover

enumeratedValue.name: OUTMODE_7
enumeratedValue.description: Enable gated clock output while counter is active

enumeratedValue.name: COINIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Co-channel counter/timers cannot force a re-initialization of this counter/timer

enumeratedValue.name: COINIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Co-channel counter/timers may force a re-initialization of this counter/timer

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count up.

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count down.

enumeratedValue.name: LENGTH_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count until roll over at $FFFF and continue from $0000.

enumeratedValue.name: LENGTH_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare, then re-initialize. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, alternating values of COMP1 and COMP2 are used to generate successful comparisons. For example, the counter counts until a COMP1 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP2 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP1 value is reached, and so on.

enumeratedValue.name: ONCE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Count repeatedly.

enumeratedValue.name: ONCE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare and then stop. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, the counter re-initializes after reaching the COMP1 value, continues to count to the COMP2 value, and then stops.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period will maintain this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period will maintain this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

enumeratedValue.name: NOTLOCKED_DO_NOT_MON_PLL
enumeratedValue.description: Not locked. Do not monitor PLL operation. Resetting of the fractional delay block in case of PLL losing lock will be controlled by software.

enumeratedValue.description: Not locked. Monitor PLL operation to automatically disable the fractional delay block when the PLL encounters problems.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED_DO_NOT_MON_PLL
enumeratedValue.description: Locked. Do not monitor PLL operation. Resetting of the fractional delay block in case of PLL losing lock will be controlled by software. These bits are write protected until the next reset.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FAULTx CPU interrupt requests disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FAULTx CPU interrupt requests enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFPINx]. If neither FHALF nor FFULL is set then the fault condition cannot be cleared. The PWM outputs disabled by this fault input will not be re-enabled until the actual FAULTx input signal de-asserts since the fault input will combinationally disable the PWM outputs (as programmed in DISMAPn).

enumeratedValue.name: SAFE
enumeratedValue.description: Safe mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear and FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FHLAF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: MANUAL
enumeratedValue.description: Manual fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. This is further controlled by FCTRL[FSAFE].

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are enabled when FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFLAGx]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 0 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 1 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: No fault on the FAULTx pin.

enumeratedValue.name: FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: Fault on the FAULTx pin.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a half cycle (as defined by VAL0).

field.name: ASRCEN
field.description: ASRC Enable Enable the operation of ASRC.

field.name: ASREA
field.description: ASRC Enable A Enable the operation of the conversion A of ASRC

field.name: ASREB
field.description: ASRC Enable B Enable the operation of the conversion B of ASRC

field.name: ASREC
field.description: ASRC Enable C Enable the operation of the conversion C of ASRC

field.name: SRST
field.description: Software Reset This bit is self-clear bit

field.name: IDRA
field.description: Use Ideal Ratio for Pair A When USRA=0, this bit has no usage

field.name: USRA
field.description: Use Ratio for Pair A Use ratio as the input to ASRC

field.name: IDRB
field.description: Use Ideal Ratio for Pair B When USRB=0, this bit has no usage

field.name: USRB
field.description: Use Ratio for Pair B Use ratio as the input to ASRC

field.name: IDRC
field.description: Use Ideal Ratio for Pair C When USRC=0, this bit has no usage

field.name: USRC
field.description: Use Ratio for Pair C Use ratio as the input to ASRC

field.name: ATSA
field.description: ASRC Pair A Automatic Selection For Processing Options When this bit is 1, pair A will automatic update its pre-processing and post-processing options (ASRCFG: PREMODA, ASRCFG:POSTMODA see ASRC Misc Control Register 1 for Pair CASRC Filter Configuration Status Register ) based on the frequencies it detected

field.name: ATSB
field.description: ASRC Pair B Automatic Selection For Processing Options When this bit is 1, pair B will automatic update its pre-processing and post-processing options (ASRCFG: PREMODB, ASRCFG:POSTMODB see ASRC Misc Control Register 1 for Pair CASRC Filter Configuration Status Register ) based on the frequencies it detected

field.name: ATSC
field.description: ASRC Pair C Automatic Selection For Processing Options When this bit is 1, pair C will automatic update its pre-processing and post-processing options (ASRCFG: PREMODC, ASRCFG:POSTMODC see ASRC Misc Control Register 1 for Pair CASRC Filter Configuration Status Register ) based on the frequencies it detected

field.name: PREMODA
field.description: Pre-Processing Configuration for Conversion Pair A These bits will be read/write by user if ASRCTR:ATSA=0, and can also be automatically updated by the ASRC internal logic if ASRCTR:ATSA=1 (see ASRC Misc Control Register 1 for Pair CASRC Control Register )

enumeratedValue.name: PREMODA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Select Upsampling-by-2 as defined in Signal processing flowBy flowing through different processing branches and different setups of the pre-filter, this ASRC scheme can be used to handle different rate conversion requirements.

enumeratedValue.name: PREMODA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Select Direct-Connection as defined in Signal processing flowBy flowing through different processing branches and different setups of the pre-filter, this ASRC scheme can be used to handle different rate conversion requirements.

enumeratedValue.name: PREMODA_2
enumeratedValue.description: Select Downsampling-by-2 as defined in Signal processing flowBy flowing through different processing branches and different setups of the pre-filter, this ASRC scheme can be used to handle different rate conversion requirements.

enumeratedValue.name: PREMODA_3
enumeratedValue.description: Select passthrough mode. In this case, POSTMODA[1-0] have no use.

field.name: POSTMODA
field.description: Post-Processing Configuration for Conversion Pair A These bits will be read/write by user if ASRCTR:ATSA=0, and can also be automatically updated by the ASRC internal logic if ASRCTR:ATSA=1 (see ASRC Misc Control Register 1 for Pair CASRC Control Register )

enumeratedValue.name: POSTMODA_0

enumeratedValue.name: POSTMODA_2

field.name: PREMODB

field.name: AOCDB

field.name: AIDEA
field.description: Number of data in Input Data Buffer A is less than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data still available in ASRDIRA is less than threshold and the processor can write data to ASRDIRA

field.name: AIDEB
field.description: Number of data in Input Data Buffer B is less than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data still available in ASRDIRB is less than threshold and the processor can write data to ASRDIRB

field.name: AIDEC
field.description: Number of data in Input Data Buffer C is less than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data still available in ASRDIRC is less than threshold and the processor can write data to ASRDIRC

field.name: AODFA
field.description: Number of data in Output Data Buffer A is greater than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data already existing in ASRDORA is greater than threshold and the processor can read data from ASRDORA

field.name: AODFB
field.description: Number of data in Output Data Buffer B is greater than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data already existing in ASRDORB is greater than threshold and the processor can read data from ASRDORB

field.name: AODFC
field.description: Number of data in Output Data Buffer C is greater than threshold When set, this bit indicates that number of data already existing in ASRDORC is greater than threshold and the processor can read data from ASRDORC

field.name: AOLE
field.description: Overload Error Flag When set, this bit indicates that the task rate is too high for the ASRC to handle

field.name: FPWT
field.description: FP is in wait states This bit is for debug only

field.name: AIDUA
field.description: Input Data Buffer A has underflowed When set, this bit indicates that input data buffer A has underflowed

field.name: AIDUB
field.description: Input Data Buffer B has underflowed When set, this bit indicates that input data buffer B has underflowed

field.name: AIDUC
field.description: Input Data Buffer C has underflowed When set, this bit indicates that input data buffer C has underflowed

field.name: AODOA
field.description: Output Data Buffer A has overflowed When set, this bit indicates that output data buffer A has overflowed

field.name: AODOB
field.description: Output Data Buffer B has overflowed When set, this bit indicates that output data buffer B has overflowed

field.name: AODOC
field.description: Output Data Buffer C has overflowed When set, this bit indicates that output data buffer C has overflowed

field.name: AIOLA
field.description: Pair A Input Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair A input task is oveloaded

field.name: AIOLB
field.description: Pair B Input Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair B input task is oveloaded

field.name: AIOLC
field.description: Pair C Input Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair C input task is oveloaded

field.name: AOOLA
field.description: Pair A Output Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair A output task is oveloaded

field.name: AOOLB
field.description: Pair B Output Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair B output task is oveloaded

field.name: AOOLC
field.description: Pair C Output Task Overload When set, this bit indicates that pair C output task is oveloaded

field.name: ATQOL
field.description: Task Queue FIFO overload When set, this bit indicates that task queue FIFO logic is oveloaded

field.name: DSLCNT
field.description: DSL Counter Input to FIFO ready When set, this bit indicates that new DSL counter information is stored in the internal ASRC FIFO

register.name: ASRMCRA
register.description: ASRC Misc Control Register for Pair A

field.name: INFIFO_THRESHOLDA
field.description: The threshold for Pair A's input FIFO per channel These bits stand for the threshold for Pair A's input FIFO per channel

field.name: RSYNOFA
field.description: Re-sync Output FIFO Channel Counter If bit set, force ASRCCR:ACOA=0

field.name: RSYNIFA
field.description: Re-sync Input FIFO Channel Counter If bit set, force ASRCCR:ACIA=0

field.name: OUTFIFO_THRESHOLDA
field.description: The threshold for Pair A's output FIFO per channel These bits stand for the threshold for Pair A's output FIFO per channel

field.name: BYPASSPOLYA
field.description: Bypass Polyphase Filtering for Pair A This bit will determine whether the polyphase filtering part of Pair A conversion will be bypassed

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSPOLYA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Don't bypass polyphase filtering.

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSPOLYA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bypass polyphase filtering.

field.name: BUFSTALLA
field.description: Stall Pair A conversion in case of Buffer Near Empty/Full Condition This bit will determine whether the near empty/full FIFO condition will stall the rate conversion for pair A

enumeratedValue.name: BUFSTALLA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Don't stall Pair A conversion even in case of near empty/full FIFO conditions.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFSTALLA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Stall Pair A conversion in case of near empty/full FIFO conditions.

field.name: EXTTHRSHA
field.description: Use external thresholds for FIFO control of Pair A This bit will determine whether the FIFO thresholds externally defined in this register is used to control ASRC internal FIFO logic for pair A

enumeratedValue.name: EXTTHRSHA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use default thresholds.

enumeratedValue.name: EXTTHRSHA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use external defined thresholds.

field.name: ZEROBUFA
field.description: Initialize buf of Pair A when pair A is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROBUFA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Zeroize the buffer

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROBUFA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Don't zeroize the buffer

register.name: ASRFSTA

field.description: The fillings for Pair A's input FIFO per channel These bits stand for the fillings for Pair A's input FIFO per channel

field.description: Input FIFO is near Empty for Pair A This bit is to indicate whether the input FIFO of Pair A is near empty

field.name: OUTFIFO_FILLA
field.description: The fillings for Pair A's output FIFO per channel These bits stand for the fillings for Pair A's output FIFO per channel

field.name: OAFA
field.description: Output FIFO is near Full for Pair A This bit is to indicate whether the output FIFO of Pair A is near full

register.name: ASRMCRB

field.name: RSYNIFB
field.description: Re-sync Input FIFO Channel Counter If bit set, force ASRCCR:ACIB=0

field.name: OUTFIFO_THRESHOLDB
field.description: The threshold for Pair B's output FIFO per channel These bits stand for the threshold for Pair B's output FIFO per channel

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSPOLYB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Don't bypass polyphase filtering.

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSPOLYB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bypass polyphase filtering.

field.name: BUFSTALLB

enumeratedValue.name: BUFSTALLB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Don't stall Pair B conversion even in case of near empty/full FIFO conditions.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFSTALLB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Stall Pair B conversion in case of near empty/full FIFO conditions.

enumeratedValue.name: EXTTHRSHB_0

enumeratedValue.name: EXTTHRSHB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use external defined thresholds.
