enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum is not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Padding not removed.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

register.name: RCMR%s
register.description: Receive Classification Match Register for Class n

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled (default): no compares will occur and the classification indicator for this class will never assert.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The register contents are valid and a comparison with all compare values is done when a VLAN frame is received.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The DMA controller's channel for the class is not used. Disabling the DMA controller of a class also requires disabling the class match comparator for the class (see registers RCMRn). When class 1 and class 2 queues are disabled then their frames will be placed in queue 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable the DMA controller to support the corresponding descriptor ring for this class of traffic.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The traffic shaper function should consider 12 octets of IPG in addition to the frame data transferred for a frame when doing bandwidth calculations. This is the default.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Addition of 12 bytes for the IPG should be omitted when calculating the bandwidth (for traffic shaping, when writing a frame into the transmit FIFO, the shaper will usually consider 12 bytes of IPG for every frame as part of the bandwidth allocated by the frame. This addition can be suppressed, meaning short frames will become more bandwidth than large frames due to the relation of data to IPG overhead).

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer starts incrementing.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output external pin frc_evt_period assertion on period event

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

enumeratedValue.description: MAC control frames with any opcode other than 0x0001 (pause frame) are accepted and forwarded to the client interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: MAC control frames with any opcode other than 0x0001 (pause frame) are silently discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The payload length check is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The core checks the frame's payload length with the frame length/type field. Errors are indicated in the EIR[PLR] field.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: No PAUSE frame transmitted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The MAC stops transmission of data frames after the current transmission is complete.

field.name: ADDSEL
field.description: Source MAC Address Select On Transmit

enumeratedValue.name: VAL_MAC
enumeratedValue.description: Node MAC address programmed on PADDR1/2 registers.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The source MAC address is not modified by the MAC.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The MAC overwrites the source MAC address with the programmed MAC address according to ADDSEL.

field.name: CRCFWD
field.description: Forward Frame From Application With CRC

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: TxBD[TC] controls whether the frame has a CRC from the application.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter does not append any CRC to transmitted frames, as it is expecting a frame with CRC from the application.

field.name: PADDR2
field.description: Bytes 4 (bits 31:24) and 5 (bits 23:16) of the 6-byte individual address used for exact match, and the source address field in PAUSE frames

enumeratedValue.description: Use MII/GMII TX clocks.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Use ENET system clock.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable Interrupt coalescing.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable Interrupt coalescing.

enumeratedValue.description: Use MII/GMII TX clocks.

enumeratedValue.description: Use ENET system clock.

field.description: Value Of Receive FIFO Section Full Threshold

field.name: RX_SECTION_EMPTY
field.description: Value Of The Receive FIFO Section Empty Threshold

field.description: RX Status FIFO Section Empty Threshold

field.name: RX_ALMOST_EMPTY
field.description: Value Of The Receive FIFO Almost Empty Threshold

field.name: RX_ALMOST_FULL
field.description: Value Of The Receive FIFO Almost Full Threshold

field.name: TX_SECTION_EMPTY
field.description: Value Of The Transmit FIFO Section Empty Threshold

field.name: TX_ALMOST_EMPTY
field.description: Value of Transmit FIFO Almost Empty Threshold

field.name: TX_ALMOST_FULL
field.description: Value Of The Transmit FIFO Almost Full Threshold

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum is not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Checksum not inserted.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Padding not removed.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer starts incrementing.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output external pin frc_evt_period assertion on period event

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Disable.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

field.name: GPTLD
field.description: General Purpose Timer Load Value These bit fields are loaded to GPTCNT bits when GPTRST bit is set '1b'

field.name: GPTCNT
field.description: General Purpose Timer Counter. This field is the count value of the countdown timer.

field.name: GPTMODE
field.description: General Purpose Timer Mode In one shot mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt, and stop until the counter is reset by software; In repeat mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt and automatically reload the counter value from GPTLD bits to start again

enumeratedValue.name: GPTMODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: One Shot Mode

enumeratedValue.name: GPTMODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Repeat Mode

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRST_0
enumeratedValue.description: No action

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in n_GPTIMER0LD

field.name: GPTRUN
field.description: General Purpose Timer Run GPTCNT bits are not effected when setting or clearing this bit.

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRUN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Stop counting

enumeratedValue.name: GPTRUN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Run

field.description: Enables the feature to auto-clear the CLKGATE bit if there is wakeup event while USB is suspended

field.name: ENAUTOCLR_PHY_PWD

enumeratedValue.description: Carrier is present

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: No carrier

field.name: LCARR
field.description: Loss of Carrier When the DTXSTS bit is set in the MAC_OPERATION_MODE register, this bit indicates that the loss of carrier occurred during packet transmission, that is, the phy_crs_i signal was inactive for one or more transmission clock periods during packet transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Carrier is present

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Loss of carrier

field.name: EXDEF
field.description: Excessive Deferral When the DTXSTS bit is set in the MAC_OPERATION_MODE register and the DC bit is set in the MAC_CONFIGURATION register, this bit indicates that the transmission ended because of excessive deferral of over 24,288 bit times (155,680 in 1000/2500 Mbps mode or when Jumbo packet is enabled).

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: No Excessive deferral

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Excessive deferral

field.name: LCOL
field.description: Late Collision When the DTXSTS bit is set in the MAC_OPERATION_MODE register, this bit indicates that the packet transmission aborted because a collision occurred after the collision window (64 bytes including Preamble in MII mode; 512 bytes including Preamble and Carrier Extension in GMII mode).

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: No collision

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Late collision is sensed

field.name: EXCOL
field.description: Excessive Collisions When the DTXSTS bit is set in the MAC_OPERATION_MODE register, this bit indicates that the transmission aborted after 16 successive collisions while attempting to transmit the current packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: No collision

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Excessive collision is sensed

field.name: RWT

enumeratedValue.description: No receive watchdog timeout

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

field.name: CR

field.description: MAC ADDRESS1 [47:32] This field contains the upper 16 bits[47:32] of the second 6-byte MAC address.

field.name: DCS
field.description: DMA Channel Select If the PDC bit of MAC_EXT_CONFIGURATION register is not set: This field contains the binary representation of the DMA Channel number to which an Rx packet whose DA matches the MAC Address(#i) content is routed.

field.name: MBC
field.description: Mask Byte Control These bits are mask control bits for comparing each of the MAC Address bytes.

field.name: SA
field.description: Source Address When this bit is set, the MAC ADDRESS1[47:0] is used to compare with the SA fields of the received packet.

enumeratedValue.name: DA
enumeratedValue.description: Compare with Destination Address

enumeratedValue.name: SA
enumeratedValue.description: Compare with Source Address

field.description: Address Enable When this bit is set, the address filter module uses the second MAC address for perfect filtering.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Address is ignored

enumeratedValue.description: Address is enabled

field.name: ADDRLO

field.name: CNTRST
field.description: Counters Reset When this bit is set, all counters are reset.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Counters are not reset

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: All counters are reset

field.name: CNTSTOPRO
field.description: Counter Stop Rollover When this bit is set, the counter does not roll over to zero after reaching the maximum value.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Counter Stop Rollover is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Counter Stop Rollover is enabled

field.name: RSTONRD
field.description: Reset on Read When this bit is set, the MMC counters are reset to zero after Read (self-clearing after reset).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Reset on Read is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Reset on Read is enabled

field.name: CNTFREEZ
field.description: MMC Counter Freeze When this bit is set, it freezes all MMC counters to their current value.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MMC Counter Freeze is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MMC Counter Freeze is enabled

field.name: CNTPRST
field.description: Counters Preset When this bit is set, all counters are initialized or preset to almost full or almost half according to the CNTPRSTLVL bit.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Counters Preset is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Counters Preset is enabled

field.name: CNTPRSTLVL
field.description: Full-Half Preset When this bit is low and the CNTPRST bit is set, all MMC counters get preset to almost-half value.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Full-Half Preset is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Full-Half Preset is enabled

field.name: UCDBC
field.description: Update MMC Counters for Dropped Broadcast Packets Note: The CNTRST bit has a higher priority than the CNTPRST bit.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Update MMC Counters for Dropped Broadcast Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Update MMC Counters for Dropped Broadcast Packets is enabled

register.name: MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0
register.description: Layer 3 and Layer 4 Control of Filter 0

field.name: L3PEN0
field.description: Layer 3 Protocol Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 3 IP Source or Destination Address matching is enabled for IPv6 packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 Protocol is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 Protocol is enabled

field.name: L3SAM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP SA Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 3 IP Source Address field is enabled for matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP SA Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP SA Match is enabled

field.name: L3SAIM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP SA Inverse Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 3 IP Source Address field is enabled for inverse matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP SA Inverse Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP SA Inverse Match is enabled

field.name: L3DAM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP DA Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 3 IP Destination Address field is enabled for matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP DA Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP DA Match is enabled

field.name: L3DAIM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP DA Inverse Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 3 IP Destination Address field is enabled for inverse matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP DA Inverse Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 3 IP DA Inverse Match is enabled

field.name: L3HSBM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP SA Higher Bits Match IPv4 Packets: This field contains the number of lower bits of IP Source Address that are masked for matching in the IPv4 packets.

field.name: L3HDBM0
field.description: Layer 3 IP DA Higher Bits Match IPv4 Packets: This field contains the number of higher bits of IP Destination Address that are matched in the IPv4 packets.

field.name: L4PEN0
field.description: Layer 4 Protocol Enable When this bit is set, the Source and Destination Port number fields of UDP packets are used for matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Protocol is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Protocol is enabled

field.name: L4SPM0
field.description: Layer 4 Source Port Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 4 Source Port number field is enabled for matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Source Port Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Source Port Match is enabled

field.name: L4SPIM0
field.description: Layer 4 Source Port Inverse Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 4 Source Port number field is enabled for inverse matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Source Port Inverse Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Source Port Inverse Match is enabled

field.name: L4DPM0
field.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 4 Destination Port number field is enabled for matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Match is enabled

field.name: L4DPIM0
field.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Inverse Match Enable When this bit is set, the Layer 4 Destination Port number field is enabled for inverse matching.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Inverse Match is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Inverse Match is enabled

field.name: DMCHN0
field.description: DMA Channel Number When DMCHEN is set high, this field selects the DMA Channel number to which the packet passed by this filter is routed.

field.name: DMCHEN0
field.description: DMA Channel Select Enable When set, this bit enables the selection of the DMA channel number for the packet that is passed by this L3_L4 filter.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Channel Select is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Channel Select is enabled

field.name: L4SP0
field.description: Layer 4 Source Port Number Field When the L4PEN0 bit is reset and the L4SPM0 bit is set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with the TCP Source Port Number field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packets.

field.name: L4DP0
field.description: Layer 4 Destination Port Number Field When the L4PEN0 bit is reset and the L4DPM0 bit is set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with the TCP Destination Port Number field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packets.

field.name: L3A00
field.description: Layer 3 Address 0 Field When the L3PEN0 and L3SAM0 bits are set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with Bits[31:0] of the IP Source Address field in the IPv6 packets.

field.name: L3A10
field.description: Layer 3 Address 1 Field When the L3PEN0 and L3SAM0 bits are set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with Bits[63:32] of the IP Source Address field in the IPv6 packets.

field.name: L3A20
field.description: Layer 3 Address 2 Field When the L3PEN0 and L3SAM0 bits are set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with Bits[95:64] of the IP Source Address field in the IPv6 packets.

field.name: L3A30
field.description: Layer 3 Address 3 Field When the L3PEN0 and L3SAM0 bits are set in the MAC_L3_L4_CONTROL0 register, this field contains the value to be matched with Bits[127:96] of the IP Source Address field in the IPv6 packets.

field.name: TSENA
field.description: Enable Timestamp When this bit is set, the timestamp is added for Transmit and Receive packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is enabled

field.name: TSCFUPDT
field.description: Fine or Coarse Timestamp Update When this bit is set, the Fine method is used to update system timestamp.

enumeratedValue.name: COARSE
enumeratedValue.description: Coarse method is used to update system timestamp

enumeratedValue.name: FINE
enumeratedValue.description: Fine method is used to update system timestamp

field.name: TSINIT
field.description: Initialize Timestamp When this bit is set, the system time is initialized (overwritten) with the value specified in the MAC_System_Time_Seconds_Update and MAC_System_Time_Nanoseconds_Update registers.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is not initialized

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is initialized

field.name: TSUPDT
field.description: Update Timestamp When this bit is set, the system time is updated (added or subtracted) with the value specified in MAC_System_Time_Seconds_Update and MAC_System_Time_Nanoseconds_Update registers.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is not updated

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp is updated

field.name: TSADDREG
field.description: Update Addend Register When this bit is set, the content of the Timestamp Addend register is updated in the PTP block for fine correction.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Addend Register is not updated

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Addend Register is updated

field.name: PTGE
field.description: Presentation Time Generation Enable When this bit is set the Presentation Time generation will be enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Presentation Time Generation is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Presentation Time Generation is enabled

field.name: TSENALL
field.description: Enable Timestamp for All Packets When this bit is set, the timestamp snapshot is enabled for all packets received by the MAC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp for All Packets disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp for All Packets enabled

field.name: TSCTRLSSR
field.description: Timestamp Digital or Binary Rollover Control When this bit is set, the Timestamp Low register rolls over after 0x3B9A_C9FF value (that is, 1 nanosecond accuracy) and increments the timestamp (High) seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Digital or Binary Rollover Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Digital or Binary Rollover Control is enabled

field.name: TSVER2ENA
field.description: Enable PTP Packet Processing for Version 2 Format When this bit is set, the IEEE 1588 version 2 format is used to process the PTP packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: PTP Packet Processing for Version 2 Format is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: PTP Packet Processing for Version 2 Format is enabled

field.name: TSIPENA
field.description: Enable Processing of PTP over Ethernet Packets When this bit is set, the MAC receiver processes the PTP packets encapsulated directly in the Ethernet packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP over Ethernet Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP over Ethernet Packets is enabled

field.name: TSIPV6ENA
field.description: Enable Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv6-UDP When this bit is set, the MAC receiver processes the PTP packets encapsulated in IPv6-UDP packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv6-UDP is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv6-UDP is enabled

field.name: TSIPV4ENA
field.description: Enable Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv4-UDP When this bit is set, the MAC receiver processes the PTP packets encapsulated in IPv4-UDP packets.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv4-UDP is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Processing of PTP Packets Sent over IPv4-UDP is enabled

field.name: TSEVNTENA
field.description: Enable Timestamp Snapshot for Event Messages When this bit is set, the timestamp snapshot is taken only for event messages (SYNC, Delay_Req, Pdelay_Req, or Pdelay_Resp).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Snapshot for Event Messages is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Snapshot for Event Messages is enabled

field.name: TSMSTRENA
field.description: Enable Snapshot for Messages Relevant to Master When this bit is set, the snapshot is taken only for the messages that are relevant to the master node.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Snapshot for Messages Relevant to Master is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Snapshot for Messages Relevant to Master is enabled

field.name: SNAPTYPSEL
field.description: Select PTP packets for Taking Snapshots These bits, along with Bits 15 and 14, decide the set of PTP packet types for which snapshot needs to be taken.

field.name: TSENMACADDR
field.description: Enable MAC Address for PTP Packet Filtering When this bit is set, the DA MAC address (that matches any MAC Address register) is used to filter the PTP packets when PTP is directly sent over Ethernet.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MAC Address for PTP Packet Filtering is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MAC Address for PTP Packet Filtering is enabled

field.name: CSC
field.description: Enable checksum correction during OST for PTP over UDP/IPv4 packets When this bit is set, the last two bytes of PTP message sent over UDP/IPv4 is updated to keep the UDP checksum correct, for changes made to origin timestamp and/or correction field as part of one step timestamp operation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: checksum correction during OST for PTP over UDP/IPv4 packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: checksum correction during OST for PTP over UDP/IPv4 packets is enabled

field.name: ESTI
field.description: External System Time Input When this bit is set, the MAC uses the external 64-bit reference System Time input for the following: - To take the timestamp provided as status - To insert the timestamp in transmit PTP packets when One-step Timestamp or Timestamp Offload feature is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: External System Time Input is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: External System Time Input is enabled

field.name: TXTSSTSM
field.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Mode When this bit is set, the MAC overwrites the earlier transmit timestamp status even if it is not read by the software.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Mode is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Mode is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AV 802.1AS Mode is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AV 802.1AS Mode is enabled

field.name: SNSINC
field.description: Sub-nanosecond Increment Value This field contains the sub-nanosecond increment value, represented in nanoseconds multiplied by 2^8.

field.name: SSINC
field.description: Sub-second Increment Value The value programmed in this field is accumulated every clock cycle (of clk_ptp_i) with the contents of the sub-second register.

field.name: TSS
field.description: Timestamp Second The value in this field indicates the current value in seconds of the System Time maintained by the MAC.

field.name: TSSS
field.description: Timestamp Sub Seconds The value in this field has the sub-second representation of time, with an accuracy of 0.

field.name: TSS
field.description: Timestamp Seconds The value in this field is the seconds part of the update.

field.name: TSSS
field.description: Timestamp Sub Seconds The value in this field is the sub-seconds part of the update.

field.name: ADDSUB
field.description: Add or Subtract Time When this bit is set, the time value is subtracted with the contents of the update register.

enumeratedValue.name: ADD
enumeratedValue.description: Add time

enumeratedValue.name: SUB
enumeratedValue.description: Subtract time

field.name: TSAR
field.description: Timestamp Addend Register This field indicates the 32-bit time value to be added to the Accumulator register to achieve time synchronization.

field.name: TSHWR
field.description: Timestamp Higher Word Register This field contains the most-significant 16-bits of timestamp seconds value.

field.name: TSSOVF
field.description: Timestamp Seconds Overflow When this bit is set, it indicates that the seconds value of the timestamp (when supporting version 2 format) has overflowed beyond 32'hFFFF_FFFF.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Seconds Overflow status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Seconds Overflow status detected

field.name: TSTARGT0
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached When set, this bit indicates that the value of system time is greater than or equal to the value specified in the MAC_PPS0_Target_Time_Seconds and MAC_PPS0_Target_Time_Nanoseconds registers.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached status detected

field.name: AUXTSTRIG
field.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Trigger Snapshot This bit is set high when the auxiliary snapshot is written to the FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Trigger Snapshot status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Trigger Snapshot status detected

field.name: TSTRGTERR0
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Error This bit is set when the latest target time programmed in the MAC_PPS0_Target_Time_Seconds and MAC_PPS0_Target_Time_Nanoseconds registers elapses.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status detected

field.name: TSTARGT1
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS1 When set, this bit indicates that the value of system time is greater than or equal to the value specified in the MAC_PPS1_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS1_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS1 status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS1 status detected

field.name: TSTRGTERR1
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Error This bit is set when the latest target time programmed in the MAC_PPS1_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS1_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers elapses.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status detected

field.name: TSTARGT2
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS2 When set, this bit indicates that the value of system time is greater than or equal to the value specified in the MAC_PPS2_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS2_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS2 status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS2 status detected

field.name: TSTRGTERR2
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Error This bit is set when the latest target time programmed in the MAC_PPS2_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS2_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers elapses.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status detected

field.name: TSTARGT3
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS3 When this bit is set, it indicates that the value of system time is greater than or equal to the value specified in the MAC_PPS3_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS3_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS3 status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Reached for Target Time PPS3 status detected

field.name: TSTRGTERR3
field.description: Timestamp Target Time Error This bit is set when the latest target time programmed in the MAC_PPS3_TARGET_TIME_SECONDS and MAC_PPS3_TARGET_TIME_NANOSECONDS registers elapses.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp Target Time Error status detected

field.name: TXTSSIS
field.description: Tx Timestamp Status Interrupt Status In non-EQOS_CORE configurations when drop transmit status is enabled in MTL, this bit is set when the captured transmit timestamp is updated in the MAC_TX_TIMESTAMP_STATUS_NANOSECONDS and MAC_TX_TIMESTAMP_STATUS_SECONDS registers.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Tx Timestamp Status Interrupt status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Tx Timestamp Status Interrupt status detected

field.name: ATSSTN
field.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Snapshot Trigger Identifier These bits identify the Auxiliary trigger inputs for which the timestamp available in the Auxiliary Snapshot Register is applicable.

field.name: ATSSTM
field.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Snapshot Trigger Missed This bit is set when the Auxiliary timestamp snapshot FIFO is full and external trigger was set.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Snapshot Trigger Missed status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Auxiliary Timestamp Snapshot Trigger Missed status detected

field.name: ATSNS
field.description: Number of Auxiliary Timestamp Snapshots This field indicates the number of Snapshots available in the FIFO.

field.name: TXTSSLO
field.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Low This field contains the 31 bits of the Nanoseconds field of the Transmit packet's captured timestamp.

field.name: TXTSSMIS
field.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Missed When this bit is set, it indicates one of the following: - The timestamp of the current packet is ignored if TXTSSTSM bit of the TIMESTAMP_CONTROL register is reset - The timestamp of the previous packet is overwritten with timestamp of the current packet if TXTSSTSM bit of the MAC_TIMESTAMP_CONTROL register is set.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Missed status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Timestamp Status Missed status detected

field.name: TXTSSHI
field.description: Transmit Timestamp Status High This field contains the lower 32 bits of the Seconds field of Transmit packet's captured timestamp.

field.name: OSTIAC

field.name: OSTEAC

field.name: TSIC

field.name: TSEC
field.description: Timestamp Egress Correction This field contains the nanoseconds part of the egress path correction value as defined by the Egress Correction expression.

field.name: TSICSNS
field.description: Timestamp Ingress Correction, sub-nanoseconds This field contains the sub-nanoseconds part of the ingress path correction value as defined by the "Ingress Correction" expression.

field.name: TSECSNS

field.name: ITLSNS
field.description: Ingress Timestamp Latency, in nanoseconds This register holds the average latency in nanoseconds between the input ports (phy_rxd_i) of MAC and the actual point (GMII/MII) where the ingress timestamp is taken.

field.name: ITLNS
field.description: Ingress Timestamp Latency, in sub-nanoseconds This register holds the average latency in sub-nanoseconds between the input ports (phy_rxd_i) of MAC and the actual point (GMII/MII) where the ingress timestamp is taken.

field.name: ETLSNS
field.description: Egress Timestamp Latency, in sub-nanoseconds This register holds the average latency in sub-nanoseconds between the actual point (GMII/MII) where the egress timestamp is taken and the output ports (phy_txd_o) of the MAC.

field.name: ETLNS
field.description: Egress Timestamp Latency, in nanoseconds This register holds the average latency in nanoseconds between the actual point (GMII/MII) where the egress timestamp is taken and the output ports (phy_txd_o) of the MAC.

register.name: MTL_RXQ_DMA_MAP0
register.description: Receive Queue and DMA Channel Mapping 0

field.name: Q0MDMACH
field.description: Queue 0 Mapped to DMA Channel This field controls the routing of the packet received in Queue 0 to the DMA channel: - 000: DMA Channel 0 - 001: DMA Channel 1 - 010: DMA Channel 2 - 011: DMA Channel 3 - 100: DMA Channel 4 - 101: DMA Channel 5 - 110: DMA Channel 6 - 111: DMA Channel 7 This field is valid when the Q0DDMACH field is reset.

field.name: Q0DDMACH
field.description: Queue 0 Enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection When set, this bit indicates that the packets received in Queue 0 are routed to a particular DMA channel as decided in the MAC Receiver based on the DMA channel number programmed in the L3-L4 filter registers, or the Ethernet DA address.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 0 disabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 0 enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

field.name: Q1MDMACH

field.name: Q1DDMACH
field.description: Queue 1 Enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection When set, this bit indicates that the packets received in Queue 1 are routed to a particular DMA channel as decided in the MAC Receiver based on the DMA channel number programmed in the L3-L4 filter registers, or the Ethernet DA address.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 1 disabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE

field.name: Q2DDMACH
field.description: Queue 2 Enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection When set, this bit indicates that the packets received in Queue 2 are routed to a particular DMA channel as decided in the MAC Receiver based on the DMA channel number programmed in the L3-L4 filter registers, or the Ethernet DA address.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 2 disabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE

field.name: Q3MDMACH
field.description: Queue 3 Mapped to DMA Channel This field controls the routing of the received packet in Queue 3 to the DMA channel: - 000: DMA Channel 0 - 001: DMA Channel 1 - 010: DMA Channel 2 - 011: DMA Channel 3 - 100: DMA Channel 4 - 101: DMA Channel 5 - 110: DMA Channel 6 - 111: DMA Channel 7 This field is valid when the Q3DDMACH field is reset.

field.name: Q3DDMACH
field.description: Queue 3 Enabled for Dynamic (per packet) DMA Channel Selection When set, this bit indicates that the packets received in Queue 3 are routed to a particular DMA channel as decided in the MAC Receiver based on the DMA channel number programmed in the L3-L4 filter registers, or the Ethernet DA address.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 3 disabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 3 enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

register.name: MTL_RXQ_DMA_MAP1
register.description: Receive Queue and DMA Channel Mapping 1

field.name: Q4MDMACH
field.description: Queue 4 Mapped to DMA Channel This field controls the routing of the packet received in Queue 4 to the DMA channel: - 000: DMA Channel 0 - 001: DMA Channel 1 - 010: DMA Channel 2 - 011: DMA Channel 3 - 100: DMA Channel 4 - 101: DMA Channel 5 - 110: DMA Channel 6 - 111: DMA Channel 7 This field is valid when the Q4DDMACH field is reset.

field.name: Q4DDMACH
field.description: Queue 4 Enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection When set, this bit indicates that the packets received in Queue 4 are routed to a particular DMA channel as decided in the MAC Receiver based on the DMA channel number programmed in the L3-L4 filter registers, or the Ethernet DA address.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 4 disabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Queue 4 enabled for DA-based DMA Channel Selection

field.name: ESTM
field.description: EST offset Mode When this bit is set, the Launch Time value used in Time Based Scheduling is interpreted as an EST offset value and is added to the Base Time Register (BTR) of the current list.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: EST offset Mode is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: EST offset Mode is enabled

field.name: LEOV
field.description: Launch Expiry Offset Valid When set indicates the LEOS field is valid.

enumeratedValue.name: INVALID
enumeratedValue.description: LEOS field is invalid

enumeratedValue.name: VALID
enumeratedValue.description: LEOS field is valid

field.name: LEGOS
field.description: Launch Expiry GSN Offset The number GSN slots that has to be added to the Launch GSN to compute the Launch Expiry time.

field.name: LEOS
field.description: Launch Expiry Offset The value in units of 256 nanoseconds that has to be added to the Launch time to compute the Launch Expiry time.

field.name: EEST
field.description: Enable EST When reset, the gate control list processing is halted and all gates are assumed to be in Open state.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: EST is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: EST is enabled

field.name: SSWL
field.description: Switch to S/W owned list When set indicates that the software has programmed that list that it currently owns (SWOL) and the hardware should switch to the new list based on the new BTR.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Switch to S/W owned list is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Switch to S/W owned list is enabled

field.name: DDBF
field.description: Do not Drop frames during Frame Size Error When set, frames are not be dropped during Head-of-Line blocking due to Frame Size Error (HLBF field of MTL_EST_STATUS register).

enumeratedValue.name: DROP
enumeratedValue.description: Drop frames during Frame Size Error

enumeratedValue.name: DONT_DROP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not Drop frames during Frame Size Error

field.name: DFBS
field.description: Drop Frames causing Scheduling Error When set frames reported to cause HOL Blocking due to not getting scheduled (HLBS field of EST_STATUS register) after 4,8,16,32 (based on LCSE field of this register) GCL iterations are dropped.

enumeratedValue.name: DONT_DROP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not Drop Frames causing Scheduling Error

enumeratedValue.name: DROP
enumeratedValue.description: Drop Frames causing Scheduling Error

field.name: LCSE
field.description: Loop Count to report Scheduling Error Programmable number of GCL list iterations before reporting an HLBS error defined in EST_STATUS register.

enumeratedValue.name: bf_4_ITERNS
enumeratedValue.description: 4 iterations

enumeratedValue.name: bf_8_ITERNS
enumeratedValue.description: 8 iterations

enumeratedValue.name: bf_16_ITERNS
enumeratedValue.description: 16 iterations

enumeratedValue.name: bf_32_ITERNS
enumeratedValue.description: 32 iterations

field.name: TILS
field.description: Time Interval Left Shift Amount This field provides the left shift amount for the programmed Time Interval values used in the Gate Control Lists.

field.name: CTOV
field.description: Current Time Offset Value Provides a 12 bit time offset value in nano second that is added to the current time to compensate for all the implementation pipeline delays such as the CDC sync delay, buffering delays, data path delays etc.

field.name: PTOV
field.description: PTP Time Offset Value The value of PTP Clock period multiplied by 6 in nanoseconds.

field.name: SWLC
field.description: Switch to S/W owned list Complete When "1" indicates the hardware has successfully switched to the SWOL, and the SWOL bit has been updated to that effect.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Switch to S/W owned list Complete not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Switch to S/W owned list Complete detected

field.name: BTRE
field.description: BTR Error When "1" indicates a programming error in the BTR of SWOL where the programmed value is less than current time.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: BTR Error not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: BTR Error detected

field.name: HLBF
field.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Frame Size Set when HOL Blocking is noticed on one or more Queues as a result of none of the Time Intervals of gate open in the GCL being greater than or equal to the duration needed for frame size (or frame fragment size when preemption is enabled) transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Frame Size not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Frame Size detected

field.name: HLBS
field.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Scheduling Set when the frame is not able to win arbitration and get scheduled even after 4 iterations of the GCL.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Scheduling not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Head-Of-Line Blocking due to Scheduling detected

field.name: CGCE
field.description: Constant Gate Control Error This error occurs when the list length (LLR) is 1 and the programmed Time Interval (TI) value after the optional Left Shifting is less than or equal to the Cycle Time (CTR).

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Constant Gate Control Error not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Constant Gate Control Error detected

field.name: SWOL
field.description: S/W owned list When '0' indicates Gate control list number "0" is owned by software and when "1" indicates the Gate Control list "1" is owned by the software.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Gate control list number "0" is owned by software

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Gate control list number "1" is owned by software

field.name: BTRL
field.description: BTR Error Loop Count Provides the minimum count (N) for which the equation Current Time =< New BTR + (N * New Cycle Time) becomes true.

field.name: CGSN
field.description: Current GCL Slot Number Indicates the slot number of the GCL list.

field.name: SEQN
field.description: Schedule Error Queue Number The One Hot Encoded Queue Numbers that have experienced error/timeout described in HLBS field of status register.

field.name: FEQN
field.description: Frame Size Error Queue Number The One Hot Encoded Queue Numbers that have experienced error described in HLBF field of status register.

field.name: HBFS
field.description: Frame Size of HLBF Captures the Frame Size of the dropped frame related to queue number indicated in HBFQ field of this register.

field.name: HBFQ
field.description: Queue Number of HLBF Captures the binary value of the of the first Queue (number) experiencing HLBF error (see HLBF field of status register).

field.name: IECC
field.description: Interrupt Enable for Switch List When set, generates interrupt when the configuration change is successful and the hardware has switched to the new list.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for Switch List is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for Switch List is enabled

field.name: IEBE

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for BTR Error is enabled

field.name: IEHF

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for HLBF is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for HLBF is enabled

field.name: IEHS
field.description: Interrupt Enable for HLBS When set, generates interrupt when the Head-of-Line Blocking due to Scheduling issue and is indicated in the status.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for HLBS is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for HLBS is enabled

field.name: CGCE

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for CGCE is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt for CGCE is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Start Read/Write Op disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Start Read/Write Op enabled

field.name: R1W0
field.description: Read '1', Write '0': When set to '1': Read Operation When set to '0': Write Operation.

enumeratedValue.description: Write Operation

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read Operation

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE

enumeratedValue.description: Debug Mode is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Debug Mode is enabled

field.description: Debug Mode Bank Select When set to "0" indicates R/W in debug mode should be directed to Bank 0 (GCL0 and corresponding Time related registers).

enumeratedValue.description: R/W in debug mode should be directed to Bank 0

enumeratedValue.name: BANK1
enumeratedValue.description: R/W in debug mode should be directed to Bank 1

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Gate Control List Address: (GCLA when GCRR is "0").

field.name: ERR0
field.description: When set indicates the last write operation was aborted as software writes to GCL and GCL registers is prohibited when SSWL bit of MTL_EST_CONTROL Register is set.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: ERR0 is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: ERR1 is enabled

field.description: EST ECC Inject Error Enable When set along with EEST bit of MTL_EST_CONTROL register, enables the ECC error injection feature.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: EST ECC Inject Error is enabled

field.name: ESTEIEC

enumeratedValue.description: Insert 1 bit error

enumeratedValue.name: bf_2BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Insert 2 bit errors

enumeratedValue.name: bf_3BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Insert 3 bit errors

enumeratedValue.name: bf_1BIT_ADDR
enumeratedValue.description: Insert 1 bit error in address field

field.name: GCD
field.description: Gate Control Data The data corresponding to the address selected in the MTL_GCL_CONTROL register.

field.description: Additional Fragment Size used to indicate, in units of 64 bytes, the minimum number of bytes over 64 bytes required in non-final fragments of preempted frames.

field.description: Hold/Release Status - 1: Indicates a Set-and-Hold-MAC operation was last executed and the pMAC is in Hold State.

enumeratedValue.name: SET_REL
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates a Set-and-Release-MAC operation was last executed and the pMAC is in Release State

enumeratedValue.name: SET_HOLD
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates a Set-and-Hold-MAC operation was last executed and the pMAC is in Hold State

register.name: MTL_FPE_ADVANCE
register.description: Frame Preemption Hold and Release Advance

field.name: HADV
field.description: Hold Advance The maximum time in nanoseconds that can elapse between issuing a HOLD to the MAC and the MAC ceasing to transmit any preemptable frame that is in the process of transmission or any preemptable frames that are queued for transmission.

field.name: RADV
field.description: Release Advance The maximum time in nanoseconds that can elapse between issuing a RELEASE to the MAC and the MAC being ready to resume transmission of preemptable frames, in the absence of there being any express frames available for transmission.

field.name: NVE
field.description: Number of valid entries in the Instruction table This control indicates the number of valid entries in the Instruction Memory.

field.name: NPE
field.description: Number of parsable entries in the Instruction table This control indicates the number of parsable entries in the Instruction Memory.

field.name: RXPI
field.description: RX Parser in Idle state This status bit is set to 1 when the Rx parser is in Idle State and waiting for a new packet for processing.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: RX Parser not in Idle state

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: RX Parser in Idle state

field.name: NVEOVIS
field.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt Status While parsing if the Instruction address found to be more than NVE (Number of Valid Entries in MTL_RXP_CONTROL register), then this bit is set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: NPEOVIS
field.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt Status While parsing a packet if the number of parsed entries found to be more than NPE[] (Number of Parseable Entries in MTL_RXP_CONTROL register),then this bit is set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: FOOVIS
field.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt Status While parsing if the Instruction table entry's 'Frame Offset' found to be more than EOF offset, then then this bit is set.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: PDRFIS
field.description: Packet Dropped due to RF Interrupt Status If the Rx Parser result says to drop the packet by setting RF=1 in the instruction memory, then this bit is set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Packet Dropped due to RF Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Packet Dropped due to RF Interrupt Status detected

field.name: NVEOVIE
field.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the NVEOVIS interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Valid Entries Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: NPEOVIE
field.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the NPEOVIS interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Number of Parsable Entries Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: FOOVIE
field.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the FOOVIS interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Frame Offset Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: PDRFIE
field.description: Packet Drop due to RF Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the PDRFIS interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Packet Drop due to RF Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Packet Drop due to RF Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RXPDC
field.description: Rx Parser Drop count This 31-bit counter is implemented whenever a Rx Parser Drops a packet due to RF =1.

field.name: RXPDCOVF
field.description: Rx Parser Drop Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the MTL_RXP_DROP_CNT (RXPDC) Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Drop count overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Drop count overflow occurred

field.name: RXPEC
field.description: Rx Parser Error count This 31-bit counter is implemented whenever a Rx Parser encounters following Error scenarios - Entry address >= NVE[] - Number Parsed Entries >= NPE[] - Entry address > EOF data entry address The counter is cleared when the register is read.

field.name: RXPECOVF
field.description: Rx Parser Error Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the MTL_RXP_ERROR_CNT (RXPEC) Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Error count overflow not occurred

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Parser Error count overflow occurred

register.name: MTL_RXP_INDIRECT_ACC_CONTROL_STATUS
register.description: RXP Indirect Access Control and Status

field.name: ADDR
field.description: FRP Instruction Table Offset Address This field indicates the ADDR of the 32-bit entry in Rx parser instruction table.

field.name: WRRDN
field.description: Read Write Control When this bit is set to 1 indicates the write operation to the Rx Parser Memory.

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read operation to the Rx Parser Memory

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE
enumeratedValue.description: Write operation to the Rx Parser Memory

field.name: STARTBUSY

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: hardware not busy

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: hardware is busy (Read/Write operation from/to the Rx Parser Memory)

field.name: DATA
field.description: FRP Instruction Table Write/Read Data Software should write this register before issuing any write command.

field.name: FTQ

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: TXQEN
field.description: Transmit Queue Enable This field is used to enable/disable the transmit queue 0.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Not enabled

enumeratedValue.name: EN_IF_AV
enumeratedValue.description: Enable in AV mode (Reserved in non-AV)

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled

field.description: Transmit Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Tx Queue.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is detected

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH

field.name: TWCSTS

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

field.name: ABS
field.description: Average Bits per Slot This field contains the average transmitted bits per slot.

field.name: ISCQW
field.description: Quantum or Weights When the DCB operation is enabled with DWRR algorithm for Queue 0 traffic, this field contains the quantum value in bytes to be added to credit during every queue scanning cycle.

field.name: TXUNFIS
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Transmit Queue had an underflow while transmitting the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: ABPSIS
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status When set, this bit indicates that the MAC has updated the ABS value.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status detected

field.name: TXUIE
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Transmit Queue Underflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is enabled

field.name: ABPSIE
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the MAC asserts the sbd_intr_o or mci_intr_o interrupt when the average bits per slot status is updated.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RXOVFIS
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Receive Queue had an overflow while receiving the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: RXOIE
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Receive Queue Overflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RTC
field.description: Receive Queue Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Rx queue (in bytes): The received packet is transferred to the application or DMA when the packet size within the MTL Rx queue is larger than the threshold.

field.name: FUP
field.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets When this bit is set, the Rx queue forwards the undersized good packets (packets with no error and length less than 64 bytes), including pad-bytes and CRC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is enabled

field.name: FEP
field.description: Forward Error Packets When this bit is reset, the Rx queue drops packets with error status (CRC error, GMII_ER, watchdog timeout, or overflow).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is enabled

field.name: RSF
field.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos reads a packet from the Rx queue only after the complete packet has been written to it, ignoring the RTC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: DIS_TCP_EF
field.description: Disable Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets When this bit is set, the MAC does not drop the packets which only have the errors detected by the Receive Checksum Offload engine.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is disabled

field.name: EHFC
field.description: Enable Hardware Flow Control When this bit is set, the flow control signal operation, based on the fill-level of Rx queue, is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is enabled

field.name: RFA
field.description: Threshold for Activating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is activated: For more information on encoding for this field, see RFD.

field.name: RFD
field.description: Threshold for Deactivating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex modes) These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is de-asserted after activation: - 0: Full minus 1 KB, that is, FULL 1 KB - 1: Full minus 1.

field.name: RQS
field.description: Receive Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Receive queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue empty

enumeratedValue.name: BLW_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level below flow-control deactivate threshold

field.name: RXQ_FRM_ARBIT

enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flush Transmit Queue is enabled

field.name: TSF

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: TXQEN

enumeratedValue.description: Not enabled

enumeratedValue.name: EN_IF_AV
enumeratedValue.description: Enable in AV mode (Reserved in non-AV)

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled

field.name: TTC
field.description: Transmit Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Tx Queue.

field.name: TQS
field.description: Transmit Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Transmit queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

field.name: UFFRMCNT
field.description: Underflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets aborted by the controller because of Tx Queue Underflow.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow detected for Underflow Packet Counter

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue in Pause status is detected

field.name: RTC
field.description: Receive Queue Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Rx queue (in bytes): The received packet is transferred to the application or DMA when the packet size within the MTL Rx queue is larger than the threshold.

field.name: FUP
field.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets When this bit is set, the Rx queue forwards the undersized good packets (packets with no error and length less than 64 bytes), including pad-bytes and CRC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is enabled

field.name: FEP
field.description: Forward Error Packets When this bit is reset, the Rx queue drops packets with error status (CRC error, GMII_ER, watchdog timeout, or overflow).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is enabled

field.name: RSF
field.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos reads a packet from the Rx queue only after the complete packet has been written to it, ignoring the RTC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: DIS_TCP_EF
field.description: Disable Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets When this bit is set, the MAC does not drop the packets which only have the errors detected by the Receive Checksum Offload engine.

enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is disabled

field.name: EHFC

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is enabled

field.name: RFA
field.description: Threshold for Activating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is activated: For more information on encoding for this field, see RFD.

field.name: RFD
field.description: Threshold for Deactivating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex modes) These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is de-asserted after activation: - 0: Full minus 1 KB, that is, FULL 1 KB - 1: Full minus 1.

field.name: RQS
field.description: Receive Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Receive queues in blocks of 256 bytes.
