enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Write Controller status is detected

field.name: TXQSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty Status When this bit is high, it indicates that the MTL Tx Queue is not empty and some data is left for transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Queue Not Empty status is detected

field.name: TXSTSFSTS
field.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Tx Status FIFO is full.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Tx Status FIFO Full status is detected

field.name: PTXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in the Transmit Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Tx Queue.

field.name: STXSTSF
field.description: Number of Status Words in Tx Status FIFO of Queue This field indicates the current number of status in the Tx Status FIFO of this queue.

field.name: AVALG
field.description: AV Algorithm When Queue 1 is programmed for AV, this field configures the scheduling algorithm for this queue: This bit when set, indicates credit based shaper algorithm (CBS) is selected for Queue 1 traffic.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: CBS Algorithm is enabled

field.name: CC
field.description: Credit Control When this bit is set, the accumulated credit parameter in the credit-based shaper algorithm logic is not reset to zero when there is positive credit and no packet to transmit in Channel 1.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Credit Control is enabled

field.name: SLC
field.description: Slot Count If the credit-based shaper algorithm is enabled, the software can program the number of slots (of duration programmed in DMA_CH[N]_SLOT_INTERVAL register) over which the average transmitted bits per slot, provided in the MTL_TXQ[N]_ETS_STATUS register, need to be computed for Queue.

enumeratedValue.name: bf_1_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 1 slot

enumeratedValue.name: bf_2_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 2 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_4_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 4 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_8_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 8 slots

enumeratedValue.name: bf_16_SLOT
enumeratedValue.description: 16 slots

field.name: ABS
field.description: Average Bits per Slot This field contains the average transmitted bits per slot.

field.name: ISCQW
field.description: idleSlopeCredit, Quantum or Weights - idleSlopeCredit When AV feature is enabled, this field contains the idleSlopeCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 1.

field.name: SSC
field.description: sendSlopeCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the sendSlopeCredit value required for credit-based shaper algorithm for Queue 1.

field.name: HC
field.description: hiCredit Value When the AV feature is enabled, this field contains the hiCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: LC
field.description: loCredit Value When AV operation is enabled, this field contains the loCredit value required for the credit-based shaper algorithm.

field.name: TXUNFIS
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Transmit Queue had an underflow while transmitting the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: ABPSIS
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status When set, this bit indicates that the MAC has updated the ABS value.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Status detected

field.name: TXUIE
field.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Transmit Queue Underflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit Queue Underflow Interrupt Status is enabled

field.name: ABPSIE
field.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the MAC asserts the sbd_intr_o or mci_intr_o interrupt when the average bits per slot status is updated.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Average Bits Per Slot Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RXOVFIS
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status This bit indicates that the Receive Queue had an overflow while receiving the packet.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Status detected

field.name: RXOIE
field.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt Enable When this bit is set, the Receive Queue Overflow interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Overflow Interrupt is enabled

field.name: RTC
field.description: Receive Queue Threshold Control These bits control the threshold level of the MTL Rx queue (in bytes): The received packet is transferred to the application or DMA when the packet size within the MTL Rx queue is larger than the threshold.

field.name: FUP
field.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets When this bit is set, the Rx queue forwards the undersized good packets (packets with no error and length less than 64 bytes), including pad-bytes and CRC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Undersized Good Packets is enabled

field.name: FEP
field.description: Forward Error Packets When this bit is reset, the Rx queue drops packets with error status (CRC error, GMII_ER, watchdog timeout, or overflow).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Forward Error Packets is enabled

field.name: RSF
field.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos reads a packet from the Rx queue only after the complete packet has been written to it, ignoring the RTC field of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Store and Forward is enabled

field.name: DIS_TCP_EF
field.description: Disable Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets When this bit is set, the MAC does not drop the packets which only have the errors detected by the Receive Checksum Offload engine.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Dropping of TCP/IP Checksum Error Packets is disabled

field.name: EHFC
field.description: Enable Hardware Flow Control When this bit is set, the flow control signal operation, based on the fill-level of Rx queue, is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware Flow Control is enabled

field.name: RFA
field.description: Threshold for Activating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is activated: For more information on encoding for this field, see RFD.

field.name: RFD
field.description: Threshold for Deactivating Flow Control (in half-duplex and full-duplex modes) These bits control the threshold (fill-level of Rx queue) at which the flow control is de-asserted after activation: - 0: Full minus 1 KB, that is, FULL 1 KB - 1: Full minus 1.

field.name: RQS
field.description: Receive Queue Size This field indicates the size of the allocated Receive queues in blocks of 256 bytes.

register.name: MTL_RXQ4_MISSED_PACKET_OVERFLOW_CNT
register.description: Queue 4 Missed Packet and Overflow Counter

field.name: OVFPKTCNT
field.description: Overflow Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets discarded by the DWC_ether_qos because of Receive queue overflow.

field.name: OVFCNTOVF
field.description: Overflow Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Overflow Packet Counter field crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Overflow Counter overflow detected

field.name: MISPKTCNT
field.description: Missed Packet Counter This field indicates the number of packets missed by the DWC_ether_qos because the application asserted ari_pkt_flush_i[] for this queue.

field.name: MISCNTOVF
field.description: Missed Packet Counter Overflow Bit When set, this bit indicates that the Rx Queue Missed Packet Counter crossed the maximum limit.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Missed Packet Counter overflow detected

field.name: RWCSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Write Controller Active Status When high, this bit indicates that the MTL Rx queue Write controller is active, and it is transferring a received packet to the Rx Queue.

enumeratedValue.name: INACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Rx Queue Write Controller Active Status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: MTL Rx Queue Write Controller Active Status detected

field.name: RRCSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Read Controller State This field gives the state of the Rx queue Read controller:

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state

enumeratedValue.name: READ_DATA
enumeratedValue.description: Reading packet data

enumeratedValue.name: READ_STS
enumeratedValue.description: Reading packet status (or timestamp)

enumeratedValue.name: FLUSH
enumeratedValue.description: Flushing the packet data and status

field.name: RXQSTS
field.description: MTL Rx Queue Fill-Level Status This field gives the status of the fill-level of the Rx Queue:

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue empty

enumeratedValue.name: BLW_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level below flow-control deactivate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: ABV_THR
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue fill-level above flow-control activate threshold

enumeratedValue.name: FULL
enumeratedValue.description: Rx Queue full

field.name: PRXQ
field.description: Number of Packets in Receive Queue This field indicates the current number of packets in the Rx Queue.

field.name: RXQ_WEGT
field.description: Receive Queue Weight This field indicates the weight assigned to the Rx Queue 0.

field.name: RXQ_FRM_ARBIT
field.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration When this bit is set, the DWC_ether_qos drives the packet data to the ARI interface such that the entire packet data of currently-selected queue is transmitted before switching to other queue.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receive Queue Packet Arbitration is enabled

field.name: SWR
field.description: Software Reset When this bit is set, the MAC and the DMA controller reset the logic and all internal registers of the DMA, MTL, and MAC.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Software Reset is enabled

field.name: DSPW
field.description: Descriptor Posted Write When this bit is set to 0, the descriptor writes are always non-posted.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Descriptor Posted Write is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Descriptor Posted Write is enabled

field.name: INTM
field.description: Interrupt Mode This field defines the interrupt mode of DWC_ether_qos.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE0
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

enumeratedValue.name: MODE1
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

enumeratedValue.name: MODE2
enumeratedValue.description: See above description

field.name: FB
field.description: Fixed Burst Length When this bit is set to 1, the EQOS-AXI master initiates burst transfers of specified lengths as given below.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Burst Length is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Burst Length is enabled

field.name: BLEN4
field.description: AXI Burst Length 4 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 4 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 4

field.name: BLEN8
field.description: AXI Burst Length 8 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 8 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 8

field.name: BLEN16
field.description: AXI Burst Length 16 When this bit is set to 1 or the FB bit is set to 0, the EQOS-AXI master can select a burst length of 16 on the AXI interface.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: No effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: AXI Burst Length 16

field.name: AALE
field.description: Automatic AXI LPI enable When set to 1, enables the AXI master to enter into LPI state when there is no activity in the DWC_ether_qos for number of system clock cycles programmed in the LPIEI field of DMA_AXI_LPI_ENTRY_INTERVAL register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic AXI LPI is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic AXI LPI is enabled

field.name: AAL
field.description: Address-Aligned Beats When this bit is set to 1, the EQOS-AXI or EQOS-AHB master performs address-aligned burst transfers on Read and Write channels.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Address-Aligned Beats is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Address-Aligned Beats is enabled

field.name: ONEKBBE
field.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing Enable for the EQOS-AXI Master When set, the burst transfers performed by the EQOS-AXI master do not cross 1 KB boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing for the EQOS-AXI Master Beats is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: 1 KB Boundary Crossing for the EQOS-AXI Master Beats is enabled

field.name: RD_OSR_LMT
field.description: AXI Maximum Read Outstanding Request Limit This value limits the maximum outstanding request on the AXI read interface.

field.name: WR_OSR_LMT
field.description: AXI Maximum Write Outstanding Request Limit This value limits the maximum outstanding request on the AXI write interface.

field.name: LPI_XIT_PKT
field.description: Unlock on Magic Packet or Remote Wake-Up Packet When set to 1, this bit enables the AXI master to come out of the LPI mode only when the magic packet or remote wake-up packet is received.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Unlock on Magic Packet or Remote Wake-Up Packet is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Unlock on Magic Packet or Remote Wake-Up Packet is enabled

field.name: EN_LPI
field.description: Enable Low Power Interface (LPI) When set to 1, this bit enables the LPI mode supported by the EQOS-AXI configuration and accepts the LPI request from the AXI System Clock controller.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Low Power Interface (LPI) is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Low Power Interface (LPI) is enabled

enumeratedValue.description: Advance Slot Check is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE

enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status not detected

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Interrupt Summary status detected

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB

enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

register.name: SMWPJRR[%s]
register.description: Secure Memory Write Protect Job Ring Register

field.name: CMD
field.description: Command: 1h: Allocate Page - This command allocates the page specified in the PAGE field to the partition specified in the PRTN field

field.name: PRTN
field.description: Partition: When an Allocate Page or De-allocate Partition command is issued, the action is performed on the partition indicated in the PRTN field

field.name: PAGE
field.description: This is the number of the page to be referenced in field CMD

field.name: PRTN
field.description: Following a Page Inquiry Command, if the PO field is 10 or 11, this field indicates the partition to which the page specified in the PAGE field is allocated

field.name: PO
field.description: Page Owner: Following a Page Inquiry Command, this field indicates if the Page is owned by the entity that issued the inquiry, owned by another entity, or unowned

enumeratedValue.name: AVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Available; Unowned: The entity that issued the inquiry may allocate this page to a partition. No zeroization is needed since it has already been cleared, therefore no interrupt should be expected.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT_OR_INITIALIZED
enumeratedValue.description: Page does not exist in this version or is not initialized yet.

enumeratedValue.name: UNAVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Another entity owns the page. This page is unavailable to the issuer of the inquiry.

enumeratedValue.name: OWNED
enumeratedValue.description: Owned by the entity making the inquiry. The owner may de-allocate this page if its partition is not marked PSP. If the partition to which the page is allocated is designated as CSP, the page will be zeroized upon de-allocation.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No Error.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_INCOMPLETE_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Command has not yet completed.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURITY_FAILURE
enumeratedValue.description: A security failure occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_OVERFLOW_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Command Overflow. Another command was issued by the same Job Ring owner before the owner's previous command completed. The additional command was ignored.

field.name: STATE
field.description: Current State. This field represents the current state of the Secure Memory Controller.

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset State

enumeratedValue.name: INIT
enumeratedValue.description: Initialize State

enumeratedValue.description: Normal State

enumeratedValue.description: Fail State

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No error occurred

enumeratedValue.name: PAGE_NOT_ALLOCATED_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction attempted to access a page in Secure Memory, but the page was not allocated to any partition.

enumeratedValue.name: PARTITION_NOT_GRANTED_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction attempted to access a partition, but the transaction's TrustZone World, DID was not granted access to the partition in the partition's SMAG2/1JR registers.

enumeratedValue.name: READ_NOT_ALLOWED_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction attempted to read, but reads from this partition are not allowed.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction attempted to write, but writes to this partition are not allowed.

enumeratedValue.name: NON_KEY_READ_NOT_ALLOWED_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction attempted a non-key read, but the only reads permitted from this partition are key reads.

enumeratedValue.name: BLOB_IMPORT_EXPORT_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Secure Memory Blob import or export was attempted, but Secure Memory Blob access is not allowed for this partition.

enumeratedValue.name: MULTI_PARTITION_BLOB_IMPORT_EXPORT_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A Descriptor attempted a Secure Memory Blob import or export, but not all of the pages referenced were from the same partition.

enumeratedValue.name: INVALID_SECURE_MEMORY_ADDRESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A memory access was directed to Secure Memory, but the specified address is not implemented in Secure Memory. The address was either outside the address range occupied by Secure Memory, or was within an unimplemented portion of the 4kbyte address block occupied by a 1Kbyte or 2Kbyte Secure Memory page.

enumeratedValue.name: PAGE_BOUNDARY_CROSSING_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: A bus transaction was attempted, but the burst would have crossed a page boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: UNINITIALIZED_PAGE_ACCESS_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: An attempt was made to access a page while it was still being initialized.

field.name: DID
field.description: The DID of the bus master whose access to Secure Memory was denied.

field.name: NS
field.description: The TrustZone nonsecure bit of the bus master whose access to Secure Memory was denied

field.name: PO0
field.description: Partition Owner for partition 0: When read by a Job Ring owner, this field indicates if partition 0 is owned by that Job Ring, another Job Ring, Unowned, or Unimplemented

enumeratedValue.name: AVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Available; Unowned. A Job Ring owner may claim partition 0 by writing to the appropriate SMAPJR register address alias. Note that the entire register will return all 0s if read by a entity that does not own the Job Ring associated with the SMPO address alias that was read.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: Partition 0 does not exist in this version

enumeratedValue.name: UNAVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Another entity owns partition 0. Partition 0 is unavailable to the reader. If the reader attempts to de-allocate partition 0 or write to the SMAPJR register or SMAGJR register for partition 0 or allocate a page to or de-allocate a page from partition 0 the command will be ignored. (Note that if a CSP partition is de-allocated, all entities (including the owner that de-allocated the partition) will see a 0b10 value for that partition until all its pages have been zeroized.)

enumeratedValue.name: OWNED
enumeratedValue.description: The entity that read the SMPO register owns partition 0. Ownership is claimed when the access permissions register (SMAPJR) of an available partition is first written.

enumeratedValue.name: OR_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Error writing status to Output Ring

enumeratedValue.name: BAD_IR_ADDR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Bad input ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).

enumeratedValue.name: BAD_OR_ADDR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Bad output ring base address (not on a 4-byte boundary).

enumeratedValue.name: INV_IR_REG_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid write to Input Ring Base Address Register or Input Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the input ring or when the Job Ring is halted. These are fatal and will likely result in not being able to get all jobs out into the output ring for processing by software. Resetting the job ring will almost certainly be necessary.

enumeratedValue.name: INV_OR_REG_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Invalid write to Output Ring Base Address Register or Output Ring Size Register. Can be written when there are no jobs in the output ring and no jobs from this queue are already processing in CAAM (in the holding tanks or DECOs), or when the Job Ring is halted.

enumeratedValue.name: INV_JR_RESET_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Job Ring reset released before Job Ring is halted.

enumeratedValue.name: ORJRR_GT_ORSFR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Removed too many jobs (ORJRR larger than ORSFR).

enumeratedValue.name: IRJAR_GT_IRSAR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Added too many jobs (IRJAR larger than IRSAR).

enumeratedValue.name: ORSF_GT_ORS_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing ORSF > ORS In these error cases the write is ignored, the interrupt is asserted (unless masked) and the error bit and error_type fields are set in the Job Ring Interrupt Status Register.

enumeratedValue.name: IRSA_GT_IRS_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing IRSA > IRS

enumeratedValue.name: ORWI_GT_ORS_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing ORWI > ORS in bytes

enumeratedValue.name: IRRI_GT_IRS_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing IRRI > IRS in bytes

enumeratedValue.name: INV_IRSA_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing IRSA when ring is active

enumeratedValue.name: INV_IRRI_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing IRRI when ring is active

enumeratedValue.name: INV_ORSF_WR_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Writing ORSF when ring is active

enumeratedValue.name: INV_ORWI_WR_ERR

register.description: Job Ring Configuration Register for Job Ring 0, least-significant half

field.name: IMSK
field.description: Interrupt Mask. Mask the interrupt that is associated with the particular processor.

enumeratedValue.name: INTR_ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: INTR_MASKED
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt masked.

enumeratedValue.name: INTR_COAL_DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt coalescing is disabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever a job is written to the output ring. ICDCT is ignored. Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the output rings slots full is still greater than 0 (ORSF > 0), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: INTR_COAL_ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt coalescing is enabled. If the IMSK bit is cleared, an interrupt is asserted whenever the threshold number of frames is reached (ICDCT) or when the threshold timer expires (ICTT). Note that if software removes one or more jobs and clears the interrupt but the interrupt coalescing threshold is still met (ORSF >= ICDCT), then the interrupt will clear but reassert on the next clock cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
