enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: PARTITION_KMOD
field.description: The value in this field is used to modify the Blob Key Encryption Key when exporting cryptographic Blobs from, or importing cryptographic Blobs to, this partition

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G1_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G1_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G1_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G1_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G1_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G1_SMBLOB, G1_WRITE and G1_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G1_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G1_SM_B_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G1_READ and G1_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor reads (if G2_TDO=1) and key-reads are always allowed, and exporting Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches and reads are allowed (but exporting a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are prohibited (except that Trusted Descriptor writes are allowed, and importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed if G2_SMBLOB=1 or if done by a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_WRITE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes are allowed (but importing a Secure Memory Blob is prohibited if G2_SMBLOB=0 and the descriptor is not a Trusted Descriptor or if G2_TDO=0).

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_PRIVILEGE_AS_JD
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors have the same access privileges as Job Descriptors

enumeratedValue.name: G2_TD_OVERIDE_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Trusted Descriptors are allowed to override the other access permissions, i.e. they can export blobs from or import blobs to the partition and read from and write to the partition regardless of the G2_SMBLOB, G2_WRITE and G2_READ settings.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_PROHIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is prohibited, unless done via a Trusted Descriptor and G2_TDO=1.

enumeratedValue.name: G2_SM_BLOB_EXPORT_IMPORT_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Exporting or importing Secure Memory Blobs is allowed, regardless of the G2_READ and G2_WRITE settings.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of these registers.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAG_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAG2JR register and SMAG1JR register are locked. The SMAG2JR and SMAG1JR registers cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is unlocked. The partition owner can change any writable bits of the SMAP register.

enumeratedValue.name: SMAP_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: The SMAP register is locked. The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

The SMAP_LCK, CSP and PSP bits and G1 and G2 permission bits of the SMAP register cannot be changed until the partition is de-allocated or a POR occurs. The PARTITION_KMOD value can still be changed. The SMAG_LCK bit can be changed to a 1, but cannot be changed to a 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition and any of the pages allocated to the partition can be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: DEALLOCATABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The partition cannot be de-allocated and the pages allocated to the partition cannot be de-allocated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will not be zeroized when they are de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: ZEROIZED
enumeratedValue.description: The pages allocated to the partition will be zeroized when they are individually de-allocated or the partition is released or a security alarm occurs.

field.name: CMD
field.description: Command: 1h: Allocate Page - This command allocates the page specified in the PAGE field to the partition specified in the PRTN field

field.name: PRTN
field.description: Partition: When an Allocate Page or De-allocate Partition command is issued, the action is performed on the partition indicated in the PRTN field

field.name: PAGE
field.description: This is the number of the page to be referenced in field CMD

field.name: PRTN
field.description: Following a Page Inquiry Command, if the PO field is 10 or 11, this field indicates the partition to which the page specified in the PAGE field is allocated

field.name: PO
field.description: Page Owner: Following a Page Inquiry Command, this field indicates if the Page is owned by the entity that issued the inquiry, owned by another entity, or unowned

enumeratedValue.name: AVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Available; Unowned: The entity that issued the inquiry may allocate this page to a partition. No zeroization is needed since it has already been cleared, therefore no interrupt should be expected.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT_OR_INITIALIZED
enumeratedValue.description: Page does not exist in this version or is not initialized yet.

enumeratedValue.name: UNAVAILABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Another entity owns the page. This page is unavailable to the issuer of the inquiry.

enumeratedValue.name: OWNED
enumeratedValue.description: Owned by the entity making the inquiry. The owner may de-allocate this page if its partition is not marked PSP. If the partition to which the page is allocated is designated as CSP, the page will be zeroized upon de-allocation.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No Error.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_INCOMPLETE_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Command has not yet completed.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURITY_FAILURE
enumeratedValue.description: A security failure occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_OVERFLOW_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Command Overflow. Another command was issued by the same Job Ring owner before the owner's previous command completed. The additional command was ignored.

field.description: This field holds the AXI cache control transaction attribute used for the memory access.

field.name: BNDG
field.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was initiating an CAAM Secure Memory blob operation

field.name: TDSC
field.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempt to assert trusted descriptor privilege when accessing an CAAM Secure Memory partition

field.name: KMOD

field.name: KEY
field.description: This field indicates whether the bus transaction associated with the recoverable error was an attempted key access to CAAM Secure Memory

field.name: SMA

enumeratedValue.name: BINARY_EN_1

enumeratedValue.name: QR_DATA_FORMAT_5

enumeratedValue.name: BIG_END_1

field.description: This bit is set to 1 enable an interrupt every time the hardware enters in the vertical blanking state

field.description: This bit is set to enable an underflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.description: If this bit is set, the LCDIF block will assert the cur_frame_done interrupt only on alternate fields, otherwise it will issue the interrupt on both odd and even field

field.name: FIFO_CLEAR
field.description: Set this bit to clear all the data in the latency FIFO (LFIFO), TXFIFO and the RXFIFO.

field.name: START_INTERLACE_FROM_SECOND_FIELD
field.description: The default is to grab the odd lines first and then the even lines

field.name: INTERLACE_FIELDS
field.description: Set this bit if it is required that the LCDIF block fetches odd lines in one field and even lines in the other field

field.name: RECOVER_ON_UNDERFLOW
field.description: Set this bit to enable the LCDIF block to recover in the next field/frame if there was an underflow in the current field/frame

field.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH
field.description: Number of units for which VSYNC signal is active

field.name: HALF_LINE_MODE
field.description: When this bit is 0, the first field (VSYNC period) will end in half a horizontal line and the second field will begin with half a horizontal line

field.name: HALF_LINE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the total VSYNC period equal to the VSYNC_PERIOD field plus half the HORIZONTAL_PERIOD field (i

field.name: VSYNC_PERIOD_UNIT
field.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PERIOD in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: ENABLE_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during valid data transfer on each horizontal line.

field.name: DOTCLK_POL
field.description: Default is data launched at negative edge of DOTCLK and captured at positive edge

field.name: HSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the HSYNC period

field.name: VSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period

field.name: ENABLE_PRESENT
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware generate the ENABLE signal in the DOTCLK mode, thereby making it the true RGB interface along with the remaining three signals VSYNC, HSYNC and DOTCLK

field.name: VSYNC_OEB
field.description: 0 means the VSYNC signal is an output, 1 means it is an input

enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the output mode and the VSYNC signal has to be generated by the LCDIF block.

enumeratedValue.name: VSYNC_INPUT
enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the input mode and the LCD controller sends the VSYNC signal to the block.

field.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles between two positive or two negative edges of the HSYNC signal

field.name: VERTICAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the VSYNC interface mode, wait for this number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles from the falling VSYNC edge (or rising if VSYNC_POL is 1) before starting LCD transactions and is applicable only if WAIT_FOR_VSYNC_EDGE is set

field.name: HORIZONTAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the DOTCLK mode, wait for this number of clocks from falling edge (or rising if HSYNC_POL is 1) of HSYNC signal to account for horizontal back porch plus the number of DOTCLKs before the moving picture information begins

field.name: VSYNC_ONLY
field.description: This bit must be set to 1 in the VSYNC mode of operation, and 0 in the DOTCLK mode of operation.

field.name: MUX_SYNC_SIGNALS
field.description: When this bit is set, the LCDIF block will internally mux HSYNC with LCD_D14, DOTCLK with LCD_D13 and ENABLE with LCD_D12, otherwise these signals will go out on separate pins

register.name: VDCTRL4
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register4

field.name: DOTCLK_H_VALID_DATA_CNT
field.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles on each horizontal line that carry valid data in DOTCLK mode

field.name: SYNC_SIGNALS_ON
field.description: Set this field to 1 if the LCD controller requires that the VSYNC or VSYNC/HSYNC/DOTCLK control signals should be active at least one frame before the data transfers actually start and remain active at least one frame after the data transfers end

field.name: DOTCLK_DLY_SEL
field.description: This bitfield selects the amount of time by which the DOTCLK signal should be delayed before coming out of the LCD_DOTCK pin

field.name: LFIFO_FULL

field.name: FGn_BCOLOR
field.description: Background color to use when this layer is not active.

field.name: Y_OFFSET
field.description: Two's compliment amplitude offset implicit in the Y data. For YUV, this is typically 0 and for YCbCr, this is typically -16 (0x1F0).

field.name: UV_OFFSET
field.description: Two's compliment phase offset implicit for CbCr data. Generally used for YCbCr to RGB conversion. YCbCr=0x180, YUV=0x000 (typically -128 or 0x180 to indicate normalized -0.5 to 0.5 range).

field.name: C0
field.description: Two's compliment Y multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x100 (1.000) YCbCr=0x12A (1.164).

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable the CSC unit in the LCDIF plane data path.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The CSC is bypassed and the input pixels are RGB data already

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The CSC is enabled and the pixels will be converted to RGB data

field.name: YCBCR_MODE
field.description: This bit changes the behavior when performing U/V converting.

enumeratedValue.name: YCBCR_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Converting YUV to RGB data

enumeratedValue.name: YCBCR_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Converting YCbCr to RGB data

field.name: C3
field.description: Two's compliment Green U/Cb multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x79C (-0.394) YCbCr=0x79C (-0.392).

field.name: C2
field.description: Two's compliment Green V/Cr multiplier coefficient. YUV=0x76B (-0.581) YCbCr=0x730 (-0.813).

field.name: WIDTH
field.description: Width of the layer in pixels.

field.name: HEIGHT

field.description: The horizontal position of left-hand column of the layer, where 0 is the left-hand column of the panel, only positive values are to the right the left-hand column of the panel.

field.name: POSY
field.description: The vertical position of top row of the layer, where 0 is the top row of the panel, only positive values are below the top row of the panel.

field.name: PITCH
field.description: Number of bytes between 2 vertically adjacent pixels in system memory. Byte granularity is supported, but SW should align to 64B boundry.

field.name: ADDR

field.name: STEP_CNT
field.description: Step count, useage is depending on CNT_MODE.

enumeratedValue.name: CNT_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Counter disable mode: not use step counter, step completes once receiving step_done

enumeratedValue.name: CNT_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Counter delay mode: delay after receiving step_done, delay cycle number is STEP_CNT

enumeratedValue.name: CNT_MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore step_done response, the counter starts to count once step begins, when counter reaches STEP_CNT value, the step completes

enumeratedValue.name: CNT_MODE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Time out mode, the counter starts to count once step begins, the step completes when either step_done received or counting to STEP_CNT value

field.description: Response count, record the delay from step start to step_done received
